# Whoisfreaks

Best Source For Domain WHOIS Database and API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/whoisfreaks/.

## Actions

- **ASN WHOIS Lookup** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive ASN WHOIS information including ownership, network infrastructure, and IP address ranges.
- **Check Domain Availability** (read-only): Check if a domain is available for registration with optional suggestions.
- **DNS Live Lookup** (read-only): Perform real-time DNS record resolution for network diagnostics and configuration verification.
- **IP Geolocation Lookup** (read-only): Retrieve geographic location information for an IP address including country, city, coordinates, ISP, and security details.
- **IP WHOIS Lookup** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive WHOIS information for an IP address including organization, ISP, and network details.
- **Security Threat Lookup** (read-only): Check if an IP address is associated with malicious activity, security threats, or appears on blocklists.
- **SSL Certificate Lookup** (read-only): Fetch live SSL certificate with full secure cert chain, validity dates, and issuer information.
- **Subdomain Lookup** (read-only): Discover all subdomains associated with a domain name.
- **WHOIS Historical Lookup** (read-only): Access historical domain records from comprehensive database with up to 100 records per page.
- **WHOIS Live Lookup** (read-only): Fetch real-time WHOIS domain registration data directly from authoritative WHOIS servers.
- **WHOIS Live Lookup V2** (read-only): Fetch real-time WHOIS domain data using v2.0 endpoint.
- **WHOIS Reverse Lookup By Company** (read-only): Search for domains registered by a specific company or organization using reverse WHOIS lookup.
- **WHOIS Reverse Lookup by Email** (read-only): Search for domains registered with a specific email address.
- **WHOIS Reverse Lookup By Owner** (read-only): Search for domains registered by a specific owner name using reverse WHOIS lookup.
- **Bulk DNS Lookup** (read-only): Process multiple domains or IPs simultaneously, returning all DNS records in a single request (max 100).
- **Bulk Domain Availability Check** (read-only): Check availability of multiple domains in one request (max 100 domains).
- **Bulk WHOIS Lookup** (read-only): Query WHOIS information for up to 100 domains in a single request.
- **Get Domain Files Status** (read-only): Check availability and update status of domain data files including newly registered, expired, and dropped domains.
